summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for AMYA Artisanal Foods. All 23 pytest backend tests PASS (public config, products CRUD by slug, bookings, enquiries, batches, JWT auth login/me/wrong-password/cookie/bearer, full admin product CRUD + availability, booking/enquiry status, batch CRUD, settings update, 401 enforcement on admin routes). Frontend admin login flow (PRIORITY) verified end-to-end in the browser: /admin/login with real credentials redirects to /admin, all 5 tabs (Products, Bookings, Enquiries, Batches, Settings) render, product list visible with availability dropdowns, Logout returns to login. Public UI flows verified: home hero 'Good food begins with trust.' renders, Explore -> /shop navigates, Shop + category pages (/shop/oils, /shop/pickles, /shop/cashew-brittles) render products, product detail (oils) shows WhatsApp + Book Live Press buttons and NO Add-to-cart (pre-launch), Live Press booking form submits successfully and shows success state, Contact form submits successfully. No critical issues found.
action_items: Optional: tests mutated settings.announcement_text to 'TEST announcement' via /api/admin/settings PUT. Main agent may wish to reset it to the production copy via admin UI or seed reset. Not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py seed() only resets admin password when it differs — good; honours playbook idempotent seed requirement.
Cookies set with SameSite=none + Secure=true (OK for cross-origin preview). Bearer token in localStorage is used as the primary auth path in frontend AuthContext.

CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True — works in practice but technically browsers may reject '*' with credentials; using regex sidesteps this. Consider restricting to known origins before production.
Admin product update: PUT /admin/products/{pid} uses ProductIn with required 'name' + 'category' — a true PATCH-style partial update is not supported (frontend sends full object, so fine).
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout). Low priority for pre-launch but worth adding before go-live.
/api/admin/settings PUT upserts without validating policies dict shape; acceptable but could lose policies if frontend omits them.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (admin login + dashboard + public forms)
